description: Full metadata for one indexed book by book_id: title, author, Gutenberg ebook release year (not original publication year), subjects, bookshelves, download count, and detected section range (front matter reported separately; section indices may differ from printed chapters). Use search_books first to find a book_id. Costs $0.005 via x402 (requires WALLET_PRIVATE_KEY, USDC on Base).
name: get_book_metadata
